concepts.def: British letter pledging support for 'national home for the Jewish people' in Palestine; conflicted with Arab promises.
Resolution 181 dividing Palestine into Jewish and Arab states with Jerusalem internationalised; rejected by Arabs.
British, French and Israeli invasion after Nasser nationalised the canal; US pressure forced humiliating withdrawal.
Israeli pre-emptive strike captured Sinai, Golan Heights, West Bank and Gaza from Egypt, Syria and Jordan.
Egyptian-Syrian surprise attack on Jewish holy day; led to OPEC oil embargo against Israel's supporters.
Carter-brokered peace between Sadat's Egypt and Begin's Israel; Egypt recognised Israel, regained Sinai.
